test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are true regarding the title block?

Statement 1: The title block is located in the lower right corner of the drawing sheet.

Statement 2: The content of the title block is standardized and cannot be modified to suit individual company requirements.

options.text: Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false
Statement 1 is false, but statement 2 is true

solution:
The correct answer is __Statement 1 is true, but statement 2 is false__.
